request.goal: Every morning, gather news about <topic> and post a report to Notion.
request.name: News to Notion

stages.name: Watch the News Pages
stages.why: Fetch each page you follow about your topic and list today's items — title, link, a line, and a date — as one tidy list.

stages.name: Remember What Was Seen
stages.why: Keep one record per item from earlier runs so the next stage can tell what is genuinely new this morning.

stages.name: Write the Morning Brief
stages.why: Compare today's items with what earlier runs saw and write a short brief of only the new ones, plus a table of everything seen.

stages.name: Save for Notion
stages.why: Notion has no door here, so the brief is saved as a Markdown file in the folder you choose, which Notion can import; the recipe runs when you start it, not on a clock.

recipe.name: News to Notion
recipe.description: Gathers news about a topic from pages you follow, writes a brief of what is new, and saves it as a Markdown file in a folder you choose, which Notion can import.

output_folder.label: Output folder
output_folder.description: Where the Markdown brief is saved so you can import it into Notion.

saved_brief.label: Saved brief
saved_brief.description: The Markdown file written to your chosen folder, ready to import into Notion.
